dialogues.speaker: Darwish
dialogues.text: So, how about it? Fancy a crack at the "Companion Caper Chronicles" test?

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: Of course! Consolidating the knowledge you've already gained is a hugely important step... Let me just set up the map and game board!

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: Oh, you're probably wondering where the idea came from. Well, interdisciplinary research is quite complicated to begin with... So we thought, why not try to make things more interesting?

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: And as long as we can prove that our format works, it could still serve as a valuable reference for real-world battles, despite being a simulation... once we have more accurate information and data to feed in, of course.

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: And they should be able to help the Corps of Thirty, too...

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: This isn't just some game. I'm taking this extremely seriously.

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: You mean the adventure narratives? Haha, we're Akademiya students, after all. Naturally, stories based on the tales of Sumeru pack a more exciting punch...

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: Not to mention, I was talking to a scholar from Vahumana the other day when inspiration hit. I told him I could make good use of what we were talking about...

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: He nodded and said, "Yes, indeed, of course. Once you've put things into place, you simply must show me your results!"

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: A lively fellow, if I do say so myself!

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: Atashye joined the Akademiya around the same time I did, while Fadaweh arrived sometime later...

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: Atashye may look clumsy, but there's no one more reliable when it comes to handiwork — look at this board and all the pieces we use in "simulated development"...

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: As for Fadaweh... *sigh* Every time I see her, she's arguing with someone over numbers. It's not that she has a temper — she's just incredibly serious about math.

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: Whenever she gets too heated, I usually have to calm things down... That's how we ended up becoming friends.

response.speaker: Darwish
response.text: Alright, alright.

dialogues.speaker: Fadaweh
dialogues.text: Huh... Hmm... As this is a task assigned by a senior, I can't afford to drop the ball... Oh! You're one of the testees... W—Why are you coming closer?

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Oh... Uhm... Why are you asking about Darwish all of a sudden? Are you curious, too? Hehe... It's only natural — he's a very reliable man...

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Not to mention, he's very good with children... *sigh* I wish you could see him when he's teaching the young ones... Wait! No! No way!

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Only I'm allowed to watch Darwish teaching the children! You can't watch him! Don't you dare go and watch him!

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: ...Uhm... Erm... I'm sorry, I got a little carried away...

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: *sigh* This is just the way I am... It's why I don't have many friends. Y—You don't think I'm... a bit of a joke too, do you?

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Not that I can do anything about it... but even so, Darwish's still willing to stand up for me!

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Heh, you mean the "simulated development" model I'm running? I assure you, it's based on meticulous calculations...

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: It's just a shame about the data inputs... I could do a much better job if Atashye wouldn't just pull numbers out of thin air...

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Honestly, doesn't that dunderhead realize what a rare opportunity it is to work on a project with Darwish?

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: ...*sigh* I shouldn't talk about him like that — he's put in a lot of work himself. Darwish's always saying that I expect too much from people. It's not a good trait.

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Even if the reports he submits are enough to make me want to scream...

choices.text: Is this too close for you? I can leave if you'd like...

response.speaker: Fadaweh
response.text: Ah, oh, no, that's not what I meant... Ehm, but, thank you... for your understanding...

dialogues.speaker: Atashye
dialogues.text: Uhm... Would you like some fruit? Or were you hoping to ask me about the test? ...Or, ah, are you here to help me process all these materials?

choices.text: Where did all this fruit come from?

response.speaker: Atashye
response.text: It's a long story... But basically, I'm from Kshahrewar, and my current research topic is using fruit — or fruit peel fibers — as construction material...

response.speaker: Atashye
response.text: I completed my research without a hitch... but then I was left with more fruit and fruit trees than I knew what to do with. And since it's for academic purposes, I couldn't simply sell it all...

response.speaker: Atashye
response.text: Then, somehow, Darwish heard about my situation and dragged me off to help with his research.

response.speaker: Atashye
response.text: Otherwise, I'd still be fretting about them even now!

response.speaker: Atashye
response.text: Uhm, I just need you to help me collect the fruit... Oh, you want to know what impact the fruit has on the test, is that it?

response.speaker: Atashye
response.text: It works like this: once you've collected enough fruit, I'll feed it to the animals in the pens and record the effects of food and environment on living organisms...

response.speaker: Atashye
response.text: Then I'll hand that data over to Fadaweh so she can construct her model... *sigh* The only problem is that the data she wants is a little too detailed...

response.speaker: Atashye
response.text: Ah, yes, that's my handiwork! I used a little fruit peel in the pieces, and I even managed to extract some workable fruit dyes...

response.speaker: Atashye
response.text: What do you think? Pretty good, right? Now that I think about it, I've mostly been drawing designs these past few years — I rarely participate in any actual construction...

response.speaker: Atashye
response.text: But it seems that everything I learned making construction models back in the day hasn't completely left me.

response.speaker: Atashye
response.text: Alright, then. If you find anything wrong with the pieces and maps, don't hesitate to let me know!
